#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;
const int MAX_N = 10;

int a[MAX_N][MAX_N];

int add(int x, int y) {
    x += y;
    return x >= MOD ? x - MOD : x;
}

int sub(int x, int y) {
    x -= y;
    return x < 0 ? x + MOD : x;
}

int mul(int x, int y) {
    return (x * 1LL * y) % MOD;
}

int power(int x, int n) {
    if (n == 0) return 1;
    int y = power(x, n / 2);
    y = mul(y, y);
    return (n & 1) ? mul(y, x) : y;
}

int rev(int x) {
    return power(x, MOD - 2);
}

int divv(int x, int y) {
    return mul(x, rev(y));
}

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            cin >> a[i][j];
            a[i][j] = divv(a[i][j], 100);
        }

    vector<pair<vector<int>, int>> states, newStates;
    states.push_back({{0}, 1});

    for (int col = 0; col < n; ++col) {
        newStates.clear();
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
            int prob = 1;
            for (int row = 0; row < n; ++row) {
                if (mask & (1 << row))
                    prob = mul(prob, a[row][col]);
                else
                    prob = mul(prob, sub(1, a[row][col]));
            }
            for (auto &st : states) {
                vector<int> newVec;
                for (int m2 : st.first) {
                    int possible = (~m2) & mask;
                    while (possible) {
                        int bit = possible & -possible;
                        newVec.push_back(m2 | bit);
                        possible ^= bit;
                    }
                }
                if (newVec.empty()) continue;
                sort(newVec.begin(), newVec.end());
                newVec.erase(unique(newVec.begin(), newVec.end()), newVec.end());
                newStates.push_back({newVec, mul(st.second, prob)});
            }
        }
        sort(newStates.begin(), newStates.end());
        states.clear();
        int i = 0;
        while (i < (int)newStates.size()) {
            int j = i;
            int sumVal = 0;
            while (j < (int)newStates.size() && newStates[j].first == newStates[i].first) {
                sumVal = add(sumVal, newStates[j].second);
                ++j;
            }
            states.push_back({newStates[i].first, sumVal});
            i = j;
        }
    }

    int ans = 0;
    for (auto &st : states)
        ans = add(ans, st.second);
    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
